nights.title: Morat
nights.name: Morat
nights.extract: Morat is a Colombian Latin pop rock band formed in the country's capital city, Bogotá. The band is made up of Juan Pablo Isaza, Juan Pablo Villamil, and the brothers Simón Vargas and Martín Vargas. Drummer Alejandro Posada was also a founding member of the band, but left in 2016 and was replaced by Martín Vargas.

nights.title: RaiNao
nights.name: RaiNao
nights.extract: Naomi Ramírez Rivera, known professionally as RaiNao, is a Puerto Rican singer-songwriter. Based in Santurce, San Juan, Puerto Rico, her music incorporates elements of reggaeton, jazz, R&B, and alternative pop, shaped by her background in music theory and live performance. She got signed to Rimas Entertainment in 2024.
